what: Pages whose projection does not account for a delivered manuscript heading, measured by scripts/audit_manuscript_h3_sets_2026_09_04.py at the moment that instrument was first wired to run.
this_is_an_INITIAL_baseline_not_a_raise: This instrument had NO baseline. It was written 2026-09-04, given a reachable failure and two synthetic controls the same day, and was inert -- gate 8 named it NEW-GATE-WITH-NO-CALLER. Freezing its measured current state is how every ratchet in this repository began; it is NOT the forbidden act of raising an existing baseline to absorb failures that appeared after it was written. The floor below is what the corpus held on the day the instrument first ran. Any NEW page that would lose a heading breaks it immediately.
these_are_outstanding_work_not_accepted_: Both entries are live defects with named owners and named causes. Neither is absolved by appearing here. Before this file existed they were recorded NOWHERE a push could see, because the instrument that finds them ran nowhere. A register is more visible than an inert script, which is the whole reason for freezing rather than dropping.
